projection_scope: Renovation-state projection of the fixed 2025 Belgian R1-R4 dwelling stock
regional_allocation_method: National ARR and depth shares disaggregated in proportion to regional 2025 R1-R4 stock before within-region z ranking
ARR_evidence_classification: official national pathway calibration with post-2025 extrapolation
ARR_source_locator: Scenarios for a Climate Neutral Belgium by 2050; Appendix 1 Table 1; PDF and printed page 49; CORE-95 Behaviour and Technology residential renovation settings
ARR_caveat: The report specifies 2.8% per year and a 40% shallow 50% medium 10% deep distribution by 2025. The model applies these values from 2026 through 2050 to the fixed 2025 R1-R4 dwelling stock.
event_counting_note: Physical totals count state-transition events. The repeated-transition field sums, by archetype, Standard-to-Advanced events exceeding the initial Standard stock and is therefore a guaranteed lower bound.
